title: BaloPlus
description: A feature-rich portable backpack plugin with 5 upgradeable levels, SQLite storage, confirm GUI, backup system, and PlaceholderAPI support.
body:
# 🎒 BaLoPlus - Advanced Backpack System

**The most feature-complete FREE backpack plugin for Paper servers!**

BaLoPlus provides players with a portable backpack that can be upgraded through 5 levels, from 9 slots to 45 slots. Unlike other backpack plugins, BaLoPlus includes enterprise-grade features like SQLite database storage, automatic backups, upgrade confirmation GUI, and comprehensive logging - all completely free!

---

## ✨ Key Features

### 🎮 Core Gameplay
- **5 Upgrade Levels**: Progress from 9 slots (Level 1) to 45 slots (Level 5)
- **Automatic Pagination**: Each level adds a new page for better organization
- **Portable Storage**: Access your items anywhere, anytime
- **Death Protection**: Never lose your backpack on death
- **Anti-Exploit**: Cannot drop, move to other slots, or put backpacks inside backpacks

### 💎 Upgrade System
- **Dual Currency**: Upgrade using both money (Vault) and items
- **Success Rates**: Balanced rates (70%, 60%, 50%, 40%) for fair progression
- **Upgrade Stone**: Special item that adds +20% success chance
- **Protection Stone**: Prevents item loss on failed upgrades
- **Confirmation GUI**: Beautiful GUI to confirm upgrades before spending resources
- **Cooldown System**: 5-second cooldown prevents accidental spam

### 🔧 Technical Excellence
- **SQLite Database**: Reliable data storage with automatic migrations
- **Auto-Backup**: Backs up database every 60 minutes (configurable)
- **Upgrade Logging**: Complete history of all upgrade attempts
- **Sound Effects**: Audio feedback for successful/failed upgrades
- **Multi-Language**: Full support for English and Vietnamese
- **PlaceholderAPI**: Integration for displaying backpack info anywhere

### 👥 Administration
- **View System**: Admins can view any player's backpack with pagination
- **Level Management**: Set player backpack levels with commands
- **Clear Command**: Safely clear backpack contents with confirmation
- **Reload Command**: Hot-reload configuration without restart
- **Tab Completion**: All commands have smart tab completion

---

## 📋 Commands

| Command | Description |
|---------|-------------|
| `/backpack open` | Open your backpack |
| `/backpack stone <type>` | Get upgrade/protection stones |
| `/backpack clear confirm` | Clear all items from backpack |
| `/backpack view <player>` | View another player's backpack |
| `/backpack setlevel <player> <level>` | Set player's backpack level |
| `/backpack reload` | Reload configuration |
| `/backpack help` | Show help menu |

**Aliases**: `/balo`, `/bp`

---

## 🔌 Dependencies

### Required
- **Vault** - Economy system
- **Essentials** (or any Vault-compatible economy plugin)

### Optional
- **PlaceholderAPI** - Display backpack info in chat, TAB, holograms, etc.

---

## 📊 Placeholders

- `%baloplus_level%` - Current backpack level (1-5)
- `%baloplus_slots%` - Total slots available (9-45)
- `%baloplus_pages%` - Number of pages (1-5)
- `%baloplus_max_level%` - Whether at max level (Yes/No)

---

## 🚀 Installation

1. Download the latest `.jar` file
2. Place in your `plugins/` folder
3. Install **Vault** and **Essentials** (if not already installed)
4. Restart your server
5. Configure `plugins/BaLoPlus/config.yml` to your liking
6. Enjoy!

---
